editorial:
Imagine being the best at your job, but your job is killing people for a secret agency. That is the life of Ava, a top-tier assassin who thinks she is untouchable. The vibe here is sleek and cold, focusing on a woman who has pushed everyone away to stay alive. You get to see her world crumble when a mission goes south, turning her from the hunter into the hunted. It is a gritty ride that shows the loneliness of living a double life while fighting off people who know all your tricks.

Jessica Chastain does a great job playing a character who is tough but breaking inside. The action scenes are quick and punchy, though the plot can feel a bit simple at times. If you love movies where a skilled pro has to fight their way out of a trap, you will enjoy this.
endingExplained: In the end, Ava finds out her boss was the one betraying her all along. She manages to turn the tables and take out the people trying to kill her. After a final showdown, she stops being a pawn for the agency. She chooses to walk away from the killing game and starts a new life, finally free from the people who controlled her for years. It is a satisfying win for the underdog.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves spy movies and strong lead characters.
